test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum of money becomes 5 times in 15 years when invested at simple interest. In how much time (years and months) will is becomes 12 times itself at the same rate at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

A certain sum of money becomes 5 times in 15 years when invested at simple interest. 

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

S.I = Amount - P

Here,

P = Sum or principal

T = time

R = rate

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be P and rate be R

Here,

Amount = 5P

So, interest = 5P - P = 4P

Now,

4P = (P × 15 × R)/100

⇒ 4P × 100 = 15PR

⇒ R = 400P/15P

⇒ R = 80/3

Again,

To become 12 time of P

Interest would be 11P

Now,

Let the time for P to be 12 times of it be T

11P = (P × T × 80)/(3 × 100)

⇒ 11P × 300 = 80PT

⇒ T = 3300P/80P

⇒ T = 41.25

Now,

41.25 years = 41 years and 3 months

**∴ Required time is 41 years 3 months.**
